name: Jeannette Armstrong
shortBio: Syilx Okanagan philosopher, educator, and ecologist who articulated the En’owkin ecological decision-making process and land-rooted Syilx epistemology.
centralQuestion: How can consensus ethics (En’owkin) weave divergent human perspectives into sustainable stewardship of the living land?

keyWorks.title: Slash
keyWorks.description: Chronicles Indigenous sovereignty movements and the philosophical tension between extractive assimilation and Syilx land ethics.

keyWorks.title: Whispering in Shadows
keyWorks.description: Explores Indigenous eco-justice, toxic colonialism, and the healing continuity of Okanagan land-language memory.
